description: Historical NFL coaching staff data - HC, OC, DC per team per year. Records represent stats UP TO that year only (not career totals). For example, Belichick's 1991 record only includes his Cleveland years, not future Patriots success.

headCoach.yearsAsHC: Total years as NFL head coach UP TO this season
headCoach.yearsWithTeam: Consecutive years with current team as HC
headCoach.careerWins: Career HC wins UP TO this season
headCoach.careerLosses: Career HC losses UP TO this season
headCoach.careerTies: Career HC ties UP TO this season
headCoach.playoffWins: Career playoff wins as HC UP TO this season
headCoach.playoffLosses: Career playoff losses as HC UP TO this season
headCoach.superBowlWins: Super Bowl wins as HC UP TO this season
headCoach.coachRef: Optional pro-football-reference coach ID for linking

offensiveCoordinator.lastName: Last name (may be 'N/A' for early years)

defensiveCoordinator.lastName: Last name (may be 'N/A' for early years)

notes.earlyYears: OC/DC positions weren't standardized before 1970s. Many teams didn't have formal coordinators.
notes.interimCoaches: Some years may have multiple head coaches due to mid-season changes.
notes.recordCalculation: All win/loss records are calculated UP TO the start of that season, not cumulative career totals.

playbookMapping.description: Maps coaching philosophy/scheme to Madden playbook indices. Leave as team default if no clear match.
